input.answer: According to the page, the cheapest is פסגות, and after ten years I would have about 72,104 ₪ for the 60,000 ₪ I put in. But it isn't one of the banks I know, so I would ask my son before doing anything.

stuck.why: The title says 'להשקיע במדד' and there is English 'S&P 500'. To me מדד is the price index, so I nearly felt it wasn't for me.

stuck.where: The big result box '72,104 ₪ הבחירה שלכם · הזול'
stuck.why: It gives the amount but no bank or company name, so I had to keep scrolling to find out where.
'פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ' and 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)' both appear, and I wasn't sure which one actually holds my money.
Minus signs (-31 ₪, -154 ₪, -577 ₪) and English fund names made me anxious, so I stopped there.
